messages.author: 96b7a8417e9b0c75
messages.subject: WLE graded
parts:
Dear Phil, 

I'm trying to compute factor scores for a multidimensional GRADED model with mirt, and this error comes our:  Information matrix has a determinate of 0, although it produces some results. I would like to ask what tey come from? (MLE)?

Best wishes, Lucas

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: WLE graded
parts:
The determinant of the observed information matrix is required for WLEs, which is a bit of a limitation. If there isn't sufficient information in the pattern of the factor loadings/slopes given the observed response pattern then this may not be computable. It's similar to the issue of MLE estimation, but occurs for a different reason. HTH.

Phil

messages.subject: Re: WLE graded
parts:
The computations which are invalid (in this case, non-convergent) will be returned as NaN/NA values. If you are seeing numbers for other observations that's because those converged successfully. HTH.

Phil
